clues: The coffee-fed pumpkin was either Sunny or Big Mo.
The pumpkin that weighed 400 pounds was fed either seaweed or coffee.
Whoever used seaweed grew either Tubby or Sunny.
Gus's pumpkin weighed less than the one fed seaweed.
Of Tubby's grower and the compost user, one brought in 500 pounds and the other 600 pounds.
Kenji and Zeke were, in some order, the grower who used fish meal and the grower whose pumpkin weighed 600 pounds.
Big Mo belonged to either Kenji or Mabel.
hints: Look at the Tubby column in the box where pumpkins meet weights. Which two clues say something about how much Tubby weighed?
Clue 7 is a pair clue, so Tubby weighed 500 or 600 pounds. Put it together with clue 5, which also limits Tubby.
So Tubby weighed 500 pounds and the compost pumpkin 600. Clue 6 keeps Gus off 600, so Gus did not use compost.
Gus used neither seaweed (clue 6) nor fish meal (clue 8), so he used coffee. Then clues 1, 6 and 8 give the 600-pound pumpkin to Kenji.

solution.key_idea: Clue 7 gives Tubby and compost 500 and 600 pounds, and clue 5 keeps Tubby off 600, so compost weighed 600.
steps: Clue 7 gives Tubby and the compost pumpkin 500 and 600 pounds. Clue 5 keeps Tubby off 600, so Tubby weighed 500 and compost 600.
By clue 6, seaweed was not 300 pounds, and 600 is compost's. So seaweed weighed 400 or 500, and Gus's lighter pumpkin 300 or 400.
Gus could not use seaweed (clue 6), fish meal (clue 8) or the 600-pound compost. So Gus used coffee.
The 600-pound grower was not Gus (clue 6), not Mabel (clue 8), and not Zeke, who used no compost (clue 1). So it was Kenji.
Kenji used compost, so by clue 8 Zeke used fish meal, and Mabel used seaweed.
Clue 9 keeps Gus off Big Mo, so by clue 2 his coffee pumpkin was Sunny. By clue 4, Mabel's seaweed pumpkin was Tubby.
By clue 3, the 400-pound pumpkin was fed seaweed or coffee. Mabel's Tubby weighed 500, so Gus's Sunny weighed 400, and Zeke's 300.
By clue 9, Big Mo was Kenji's, since Mabel grew Tubby. So Zeke grew Duchess.
solution.epilogue: Kenji's Big Mo took the blue ribbon at 600 pounds, fed on plain compost. Mabel's seaweed-fed Tubby came second, and she announced a rematch for next October.
